name: community-ishir
summary: Ishir's ult: a shotgun blast when the mark on the enemy pops (Sheepa's clip, not in git)

assets.why: Ishir, Sever Spirit (R): the shotgun blast that plays when the mark pops. A new sound: a copy of the game's own CannonFire SoundWave (48 kHz stereo Ogg) with Sheepa's clip, 10 dB quieter than the clip (about 3 dB below the game's revolver shots).
Ishir, Sever Spirit (R): when the mark ends (it pops and deals its damage), every player hears the shotgun blast on the marked enemy, next to the mark's own end sound.
